title: Raj and the Jam
lines: Raj had a job. He got the jam pot.
Mom had buns. Raj runs to Mom.
The lid was not on. The pot tips!
Jam is on his cap! Raj was sad.
"I did not set the lid on," said Raj.
Raj gets a rag and rubs the cap.
"Raj did a big job," said Mom.
Raj has a jam bun and a big hug.

questions.listenFor: To get the jam pot and take it to Mom. Lines one and two say it.

questions.ask: Why did the jam come out of the pot?
questions.listenFor: The lid was not on. Line three says it, and Raj says so himself in line five. If they say "it tipped," ask them why that mattered.

questions.ask: Raj said the lid was his mistake and then he cleaned it up himself. What do you think of that? Tell me.
questions.listenFor: Their own thinking. There is no right answer - you are listening for a reason, not a verdict.
